ownerDirective.speaker: Governor
ownerDirective.exactText: i'm the governmor of the minecraft world and I've come to cut red tape
ownerDirective.interpretation: The finite Westlight north rail staff-platform scope is delegated to the implementation team; hard safety is not waived.

mvpBoundary.included: Only the exact new north staff-platform width, exterior containment, gravel treatment, and retained rail/tube interfaces.
mvpBoundary.exclusionRule: No public platform, passenger boarding/service, vehicle, power, signal, or rail-cell walking is authorized.

hardSafetyKernel.rule: Exact state/inverse, gravity-first wall order, retained rail/tube proofs, and independent QA are mandatory.
Fresh immutable source and exact preflight immediately precede mutation.
Forward and reverse parser validation is strict-noop.
Exact block-entity and fresh live-entity clearance are mandatory.
Execution is journaled; failure invokes exact reverse rollback.
Fresh post capture, rollback poststate proof, and independent QA precede acceptance.

operationalControls.scopeLocalFailureRule: Failure blocks only this exact North rail staff platform.
